authority: This file is the source of truth for OMNI capability lifecycle and scope. Generated documentation must not override it.

lifecycle_definitions.stable: Release-qualified for the declared platform with real effects, failure states, tests, documentation, and dogfood evidence.
lifecycle_definitions.beta: A real implementation exists and has meaningful tests, but one or more release gates remain open.
lifecycle_definitions.experimental: Incomplete, shallow, unqualified, or likely to change; off by default in the target product.
lifecycle_definitions.demo: Canned or simulated behavior intended only for an explicitly labeled demo mode.
lifecycle_definitions.unavailable: Concept or interface exists but no usable implementation is present.
lifecycle_definitions.removed: Legacy implementation retained temporarily for migration or deletion and not part of product scope.

implementation_definitions.real: Performs the represented effect through a concrete local or configured external backend.
implementation_definitions.partial: Some concrete behavior exists, but important actions, verification, or integrations are incomplete.
implementation_definitions.placeholder: Creates metadata or presentation state without performing the headline capability.
implementation_definitions.stub: Interface exists but is intentionally disabled or not implemented.
implementation_definitions.infrastructure: Internal support code rather than a direct user capability.

target_product.name: OMNI Personal Core

primary_platform.name: NVIDIA DGX Station for Windows (Windows 11 Arm64)
primary_platform.reason: The intended owner machine uses an Arm64 NVIDIA Grace Neoverse V2 CPU. Native Windows 11 Arm64 qualification is required; physical DGX GPU, model, performance, and sustained-use gates remain assigned to B11, B13, B15, and B16.

secondary_platforms.name: Windows 11 x64
secondary_platforms.reason: A conventional x64 laptop may qualify hardware-independent Windows behavior, but cannot substitute for native Arm64 evidence or physical DGX hardware gates.

secondary_platforms.name: Linux
secondary_platforms.reason: Compilation and most unit tests run on Linux, but desktop, audio, installation, and E2E product behavior are not qualified.

secondary_platforms.name: macOS
secondary_platforms.reason: No current end-to-end installation, hardware, automation, or release evidence exists.

target_product.promise: A local-first personal assistant for one owner that safely handles a deliberately limited set of daily desktop, file, browser, memory, scheduling, and voice workflows, and reports unavailable or failed work truthfully.
pre_10_non_goals: General artificial intelligence or human-level general reasoning
Production support for every desktop operating system
Cloud sync, marketplace, or mobile parity before their security and reliability gates pass
A guarantee that no network traffic occurs unless enforceable offline mode is enabled and verified

core_workflows.name: Real daily briefing
core_workflows.outcome: Summarize the owner's real local calendar, tasks, reminders, and explicitly configured sources with provenance and honest unavailable states.

core_workflows.name: Reminder lifecycle
core_workflows.outcome: Create, inspect, update, trigger, and cancel a reminder with persistence across restart.

core_workflows.name: Local document retrieval
core_workflows.outcome: Find an approved local document, extract relevant content, summarize it with source paths, and respect access boundaries.

core_workflows.name: Safe file creation and editing
core_workflows.outcome: Preview, create or modify a file in an approved workspace, verify contents, and offer rollback where applicable.

core_workflows.name: Isolated browser task
core_workflows.outcome: Open the isolated browser profile, navigate or search, verify the resulting page state, and recover from browser absence.

core_workflows.name: Application and window control
core_workflows.outcome: Launch, focus, minimize, maximize, and close approved applications on the primary platform with visible verification.

core_workflows.name: Focus session
core_workflows.outcome: Start a timed focus session, apply configured notification quieting, report status, and restore state at completion or cancellation.

core_workflows.name: Personal session recall
core_workflows.outcome: Answer what the owner did yesterday from inspectable stored sessions, with timestamps, provenance, uncertainty, and delete controls.

core_workflows.name: Local voice task
core_workflows.outcome: Accept a push-to-talk command, execute one safe core workflow, and speak the verified result through a local TTS backend.

core_workflows.name: Truthful degraded recovery
core_workflows.outcome: When the model, browser, microphone, integration, or optional dependency is absent, report the exact unavailable state and provide a tested recovery path without mock success.
